definitions.explanation: Mimics the sound or appearance of bubbles rising, liquid boiling gently, or hollow tapping sounds.

definitions.gloss: one after another; popping up repeatedly
definitions.explanation: Describes things appearing, emerging, or happening in quick succession, like bubbles surfacing.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぽこぽこ⟦{沸|わ}いている→沸く：01122_waku⟧。
⟦{泥|どろ}→泥：03492_doro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ぽこぽこ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{泡|あわ}→泡：02175_awa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: Bubbles are popping up from the mud.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太鼓|たいこ}→太鼓：04049_taiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぽこぽこ⟦{叩|たた}いて→叩く：02072_tataku⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: They're playing by tapping on a drum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぽこぽこ{出来|でき}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: New cafes are popping up one after another.

examples.japanese: モグラ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぽこぽこ⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{顔|かお}を{出|だ}す→顔を出す：06899_kaowodasu⟧。
examples.english: Moles keep popping their heads out of holes.

examples.japanese: ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぽこぽこ⟦{浮|う}かんで→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧きた。
examples.english: Ideas kept popping up one after another.

notes:
An onomatopoeic word evoking light, hollow, repetitive sounds or movements. The "poko" base suggests something round and soft emerging or being tapped. Has a playful, lighthearted feel.

USAGE:
Can function as an adverb (ぽこぽこ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ or ぽこぽこ before a verb) and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb (ぽこぽこ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). The figurative sense of things appearing in rapid succession is an extension of the bubbling imagery.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぶくぶく→ぶくぶく：06935_bukubuku⟧: gurgling; bubbling vigorously — larger, more vigorous bubbles than ぽこぽこ
- ⟦ぐつぐつ→ぐつぐつ：18531_gutsugutsu⟧: simmering — heavier boiling sound, implies cooking
- ⟦ぽんぽん→ぽんぽん：26080_ponpon⟧: pop-pop; one after another — similar in the "rapid succession" sense, but with a sharper popping feel
- ⟦ぼこぼこ→ぼこぼこ：05362_bokoboko⟧: bumpy; dented — describes an uneven surface or being beaten up; rougher connotation
